cards.scope: Verify Stability Pool recovery and current rails
cards.evidenceText: The PR #666 dependency-refresh candidate SHA-256 d8385398e5b92ca26b029b6b76ab78d634f40ced65d1f0af5b991591332329e9 is installed and running. The pool remained open and internally consistent with 13 depositors, preserved deposit and interest totals, all 237 staged interest packets credited, and empty queried recovery queues.

A private row-level matrix covers CL-01 through CL-17 and all 25 September IDs. PRs #652 through #662 and #666 are merged. Backend, bot, Stability Pool, AMM and Analytics run the PR #666 dependency-refresh candidates with preserved state readbacks. The wallet-session frontend is published after 1,740 tests and the production build. Remaining limitations are explicitly classified rather than treated as active-path blockers: partial Points source-to-build provenance, one held legacy archive-proof case, 60 preserved Treasury tombstones, and unexecuted real-provider wallet assurance.

Season 1 scoring finalized on mainnet. The open period closed and final-period compensation was applied. Earlier entries and receipts were preserved, replay added zero, and both season timers are off.

A November 15 readback shows the source-bound October 23 3pool release running with zero pending claims and 561 retained donation receipts. No unprivileged path chooses the configured ledger or its advertised archive; the generic helper's residual assumption is trusted-ledger/archive hardening, not an active remote exploit. The safe disposition is to keep the separate legacy ambiguity held until positive authenticated evidence or a reviewed recovery route exists.
